scenario_note: Synthetic city-impact dataset for evacuation simulation near Goma, DR Congo. Parallel to the severe rain-and-wind convective storm timeline, modeling how city conditions degrade over time and which map coordinates become dangerous to remain in as the storm progresses.

schema_alignment.city_state_schema_base: Timestep-aligned urban impact representation with 10-minute timestamps
